scope: Portable finite-control and integrity evidence; mathematical consistency checked against exact formulas and cited inputs; no one-dimensional resolution or novelty certification

findings.summary: Controlling assertions are removed by inherited PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1, allowing materially wrong geometry, moments, physical counts, flow calculations, manifest hashes and saved replay results to receive unconditional success records
findings.missing_input_result: Missing saved results while manifest-listed raises FileNotFoundError in both modes; retained as failure, not success

repair_items.summary: Preserve frozen sources; add a documented runner using explicit exceptions or explicitly reject optimized execution before issuing success; pin and protect the child interpreter and validate negative mutants in both environment modes
repair_items.reasonable_repair_demonstration: exact_controls.py and run_exact_controls.py use explicit exceptions, pass both baseline modes and reject all ten new mutant-mode subprocess runs
repair_items.acceptance: Wrong geometry, moments, flow, hash and replay result must produce nonzero exit without a success record in both normal and optimized environments

reproduction.source_script_dependencies: Python standard library; advertised Python 3.10 or later is consistent with int.bit_count
